Subject: Intro — FlowForge x Redwood partner model

Hi Maya,

Great to meet you last week — thanks for the intro. FlowForge builds deployment tooling for embedded products and we see a lot of mutual customers who would benefit from Redwood's hosted inference and private options.

Attached is a short term sheet (flowforge_rs_term_sheet_v1.pdf) that outlines two models we typically run: a reseller arrangement (FlowForge invoices, Redwood pays reseller margin) and a referral fee for leads we introduce. For a first-pass we penciled a 20% reseller margin and 10% referral fee.

Two quick questions for Redwood team:
- What lead-registration window do you require for credit?
- Any security/compliance must-haves before we can propose Redwood on client SOWs?

Would love to set a follow-up call this week with your commercial/ops folks to align.

Best,
Avi Patel

Avi — thanks, this is helpful. Looping Camila (partnerships) and Ben (partner ops) to get the registration/ops side set up.

Notes on your questions:
- Registration window: our standard lead-protection is 90 days from first registered lead unless there is an active opportunity in CRM (HubSpot) with >30 days of documented engagement; we can discuss extending for large deals.
- Security: we typically need a completed security questionnaire and, for some customers, a CloudBridge-style addendum. If CloudBridge will be the systems integrator on the SOW, we'll want their security contact to sign off.

Commercially — 20% reseller / 10% referral is in the ballpark. A couple of commercial guardrails we usually ask for:
- Jointly-sourced deals where Redwood provides technical support during the sales cycle get an elevated reseller margin (tiered by ARR).
- A clawback for cancelled deals within 120 days.

Can you confirm whether FlowForge invoices customers directly as reseller, or whether you prefer redwood to invoice and pay a commission? That changes account mapping and billing flow.

I'll book time for Friday for an ops + legal sync.

Cheers,
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Ecosystem Partnerships — Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Intro — FlowForge x Redwood partner model

Thanks Maya — quick answers:
- FlowForge prefers to invoice directly (reseller model) for customer billing simplicity; we can implement Redwood invoicing for deals where customers require it but that is our exception.
- We are comfortable with a 120-day clawback. For jointly-sourced deals, we'd expect a stepped margin: 20% baseline reseller margin, 25% for joint-sourced where FlowForge led technical integration, 15% referral where FlowForge simply introduced the lead and Redwood closed.

On CloudBridge: Elena is copied — they will handle SI work on larger enterprise pilots (they also require a security addendum before integrating). Elena — can you confirm your standard addendum and earliest availability to review Redwood's security questionnaire?

Also: we have a consultant (Mark Tremblay) who runs procurement for a few of our enterprise prospects and he'll join commercial calls to fast-track PO and T&Cs.

-Avi

Hi Avi / Elena / Mark — thanks for the quick turn. Appreciate the clarity on billing. Recap + next steps below so everyone's aligned before Friday's call (ops/legal/SE):

Recap of proposed commercial terms
- Reseller margin: baseline 20% (FlowForge invoices customer).
- Joint-sourced uplift: 25% when FlowForge led technical integration during sales cycle.
- Referral (introduction only): 15% referral fee when Redwood closes.
- Clawback: 120 days pro rata for cancellations/early terminations.
- Lead-registration: 90-day protection window; can be extended to 180 days for opportunities with signed MoU/LOI.

Operational asks
- FlowForge to complete Redwood security questionnaire (link below) and CloudBridge to provide their addendum (cloudbridge_security_addendum.docx attached).
- FlowForge to confirm invoicing flow for first pilot (we'll draft an appendix showing both options).
- Provide primary POC for procurement so Ben can kick off partner ledger and Net30 payout setup.

Attachments: MA redline (ma_flowforge_redline_20260408.pdf) — this is our starting draft; please mark commercial changes.

Proposed meeting: Fri Apr 10, 09:00 PT — ops + legal + SE (I'll send calendar invite).
